# Bookkeeping for hair and nail salons. Nothing else.

You didn't open a salon to reconcile bank statements at midnight. You opened it to do hair, do nails, and build something of your own. I handle the books so you can get back to that.

I work only with hair and nail salons. I know how booth rent, product sales, tips and commission splits show up in your accounts, so you don't have to explain your business to me before I can help.

## What I do every month

- **Monthly books.** I close each month by the 10th of the next month. I'll be straight with you: I missed that date three times last year. I hit it every other time.
- **Payroll for up to 10 staff.** Your team gets paid correctly and on time.
- **Sales tax filing.** I file it so it doesn't land on your desk.

## Clean books at tax time

Your accountant charges less when your books show up ready to use. Last tax season, 9 of my clients told me their accountant's bill went down because their books were clean. One of them saved $800.

## Salon owners stay

I work with 31 salons right now. Two clients left last year, and both left because they sold their salons.

## What it costs

**$199 a month.** Every client pays the same price. Until January it was $149. When I raised it, I raised it for everyone, including clients who'd been with me for years. You won't find out later that the salon down the street pays less.

## Who you'll be working with

Me. I'm one person, not a call center or a rotating team. When you have a question, the person who answers is the person who did your books. I don't take calls on Sundays or Mondays. Those are my days off, and I'm guessing they're yours too.

## Start with a 20-minute call

The first call is free and takes 20 minutes. Tell me about your salon, ask whatever you want, and we'll both figure out whether I'm the right fit for you.

**[Book your free 20-minute call]**
